stories.title: Lucia Laguna, Brazilian painter of verdant and fragmented cityscapes, has died, aged 85
stories.sum: Laguna, who only started painting after retiring from her teaching career, started to achieve success when she was in her 60s

stories.title: OpenAI agent 'infiltrated' Australian government website, PM says
stories.sum: Albanese said he expressed "concern" to OpenAI founder Sam Altman, after authorities were informed three months after the breach in June.

stories.title: OpenAI and Anthropic bosses push UN for global terms on AI
stories.sum: OpenAI's Sam Altman has called for risk evaluation standards, as have Anthropic's Dario Amodei and Hugging Face's Clement Delangue.

stories.title: LA’s Getty Museum Acquires Recently Rediscovered Velázquez Painting, a First for a West Coast Museum
stories.sum: Portrait of the Count-Duke of Olivares was attributed by Detroit Institute of Arts director Salvador Salort-Pons earlier this year.

stories.title: After a $105 M. Memorabilia Blockbuster, Christie’s Launches a Pop Culture Division
stories.sum: “I sat in the Jim Irsay sale room, and that was an experience like I’ve never seen,” Christie's Bonnie Brennan said.

stories.title: British Museum bans visitors from photographing Bayeux Tapestry
stories.sum: Some ticket holders have reportedly been turned away from the exhibition because previous visitors had taken too long taking photos

stories.title: Chiharu Shiota and Mami Kataoka Named to l’Ordre d’Arts et Lettres by French Republic
stories.sum: Japanese artist Chiharu Shiota and Mami Kataoka, the director of the Mori Art Museum in Tokyo, have been appointed to l’Ordre des Arts et des Lettres (Order of Arts and Letters) by the government of France.

stories.title: Jeffreen M.H. Ash Steps Down from Leadership of Threewalls
stories.sum: Jeffreen M.H. Ash will depart from her role as executive director of the Chicago cultural nonprofit Threewalls on September 30.

stories.title: Museums are Embracing AI, But When Will Policy and Funding Catch Up?
stories.sum: A joint report from UNESCO and the International Council of Museums has identified a disconnect between institutions’ use of AI and the structures needed support its responsible use.

stories.title: Liz Hird obituary
stories.sum: My mother, Liz Hird, who has died of cancer aged 82, was a designer, maker and teacher determined to encourage the creative work of children and adults.

stories.title: Meta’s Muse AI Assistant Rolled Out With a Serious Security Flaw
stories.sum: Meta says it issued a fix for the Muse zero-day vulnerability that would have let attackers do “whatever” they wanted on a victim’s Mac, highlighting the inherent dangers of AI helpers.

stories.title: Tyler Mitchell wins 2026 Don Tyson Prize
stories.sum: As of this year, the prize has been upped to $250,000 and will be awarded annually

stories.title: Kim Mannes-Abbott Brings Four Decades Of Digital Art To Saatchi Gallery’s British Art Fair
stories.sum: Pioneering digital artist Kim Mannes-Abbott is showing a solo presentation within Spotlight: Digitalism, the digital art exhibition at British Art Fair, held at Saatchi Gallery from 24th – 27th September 2026.

stories.title: Derrick Adams, Randy Polumbo, Wills Glasspiegel & More Artists Project Newly-Commissioned Works Onto Historic Hangars in Brooklyn
stories.sum: Jamaica Bay-Rockaway Parks Conservancy gathers 21 artists for the second biennial Floyd Bennett Field! Public Arts Festival on October 3

stories.title: How Madonna Became an Art World Icon
stories.sum: Madonna, 1990 Patrick Demarchelier Staley-Wise Gallery The legend is a classic one: A 20-year-old Michigan college dropout lands in New York with $35 in her pocket and gets into a taxi for the first time in her life…
